blocks.text: A7 Initiative charters and action register
The 112 actions in Chapter 3 are listed here by initiative, so each lead can see every action the plan asks of it and of its partners.

Section 4.3 carries the eighteen charters in full, so this appendix does not repeat them. It lists the actions from the Chapter 3 action tables in initiative order, with the tier that acts and the proposed lead and partners. The programme office loads this register into the toolkit as the Tier 3 work plan.

blocks.caption: Every Chapter 3 action belongs to one initiative, and each initiative carries actions for Wesgro, its partners and, where the lever is national, an escalation.
blocks.source: Chapter 3 action tables; initiative mapping from the traceability table. Leads and partners are proposals for Steerco to confirm.
